public.title: Number of Connected Components in an Undirected Graph
public.description: Count connected components in an undirected graph with vertices 0 through n-1, including isolated vertices. n is 0 to 1000; edges contains at most 2000 distinct pairs of different valid vertices.
hints: Start one graph traversal for each unseen vertex.
public.attribution: Original Bekor statement, examples, tests and solutions, 2026. Adapted from a standard algorithmic problem; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Every traversal marks one whole component, so counting traversal roots gives the answer. O(vertices plus edges) time.
